interactions.teaches: What the game, the creator and the photo subject actually looked and sounded like.
interactions.studentAction: Press play on a video inside the page.
interactions.feedback: The YouTube player starts inside the page.
interactions.staticFallback: Each video has an Open on YouTube link.
interactions.identityFit: Footage sits beside the moment it shows.

interactions.teaches: Verification. Four ordinary record searches disproved a story that dozens of outlets repeated.
interactions.studentAction: Run each of Deadspin's four checks.
interactions.feedback: Each check returns FOUND or NO RECORD, a tally counts progress, and a verdict appears after all four.
interactions.staticFallback: A noscript paragraph lists all four results, and the deck covers them.
interactions.identityFit: The control is a records query, the reporter's own tool.

interactions.teaches: How close the Heisman vote was and what the story was worth.
interactions.studentAction: Read three bars drawn to scale.
interactions.staticFallback: Values are printed on the bars and in the aria label.
interactions.identityFit: Gold marks Te'o as on every other real fact.
